note: This file does NOT validate against schemas/gate-report.schema.json and must not be mistaken for an accepted Gate 1 golden. GLOBAL-05 requires goldens to come from an explicit reviewer-acceptance command run against real Gate 1 code, which does not exist yet (WP1-WP3 are not implemented). This file instead freezes, per P0's mandate, the exact target values a real Gate 1 run must reproduce, so implementers have a red-test target and reviewers have something concrete to check goldens against later.

fixture_manifest_reference.note: This candidate spec references the manifest by its stable manifest_id, NOT by the manifest self-hash. This deliberately breaks the v1 circular dependency (v1 embedded the manifest self-hash here, but the manifest inventory hashes THIS file, so the embedded hash went stale the moment the inventory changed). The authoritative manifest_self_sha256 is computed last and lives only in fixture-manifest.yaml.
